title: The Gate for the Prince, Ordinances for Levites and Priests

questions.question: When the man brought Ezekiel back to the outer gate of the sanctuary facing east, what was its condition?
options: It was shut
It was open wide
It had been burned down
It was filled with guards
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 44:1 (ESV): "Then he brought me back to the outer gate of the sanctuary, which faces east. And it was shut."

questions.question: Why did the Lord say the eastern gate must remain shut?
options: "It shall not be opened, and no one shall enter by it, for the Lord, the God of Israel, has entered by it."
"Because the enemies of Israel come from the east."
"To keep the holy sacrifices from escaping."
"Because it was damaged during the siege of Babylon."
questions.correctAnswer: "It shall not be opened, and no one shall enter by it, for the Lord, the God of Israel, has entered by it."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 44:2 (ESV): "And the Lord said to me, 'This gate shall remain shut; it shall not be opened, and no one shall enter by it, for the Lord, the God of Israel, has entered by it. Therefore it shall remain shut.'"

questions.question: Who is the only person allowed to sit in the eastern gateway to eat bread before the Lord?
options: Only the prince
The high priest
The prophet
David the king
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 44:3 (ESV): "Only the prince may sit in it to eat bread before the Lord. He shall enter by way of the vestibule of the gate, and shall go out by the same way."

questions.question: When Ezekiel was brought by the north gate to the front of the temple, what did he see filling the temple of the Lord?
options: The glory of the Lord
A thick darkness
A cloud of locusts
Seven golden lampstands
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 44:4 (ESV): "Then he brought me by way of the north gate to the front of the temple, and I looked, and behold, the glory of the Lord filled the temple of the Lord. And I fell on my face."

questions.question: What specific group of people does God say shall NOT enter His sanctuary, declaring it an abomination?
options: Foreigners, uncircumcised in heart and flesh
The descendants of Esau (Edomites)
Women and children
Tax collectors and sinners
questions.correctAnswer: Foreigners, uncircumcised in heart and flesh
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 44:9 (ESV): "Thus says the Lord God: No foreigner, uncircumcised in heart and flesh, of all the foreigners who are among the people of Israel, shall enter my sanctuary."

questions.question: What consequence fell upon the Levites who went far from God, going astray after their idols when Israel went astray?
options: They shall bear their punishment; they may only be ministers in my sanctuary, having oversight at the gates and serving the people, but they shall not come near to Me to serve Me as priest
They were struck dead before the altar
They were banished from the land of Israel forever
They were demoted to slaves for the king
questions.correctAnswer: They shall bear their punishment; they may only be ministers in my sanctuary, having oversight at the gates and serving the people, but they shall not come near to Me to serve Me as priest
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 44:10-13 explains that the unfaithful Levites will serve as gatekeepers and slaughter sacrifices for the people, but they shall not come near God to serve as priests or touch holy things.

questions.question: Who alone among the Levites are permitted to come near to the Lord to minister to Him, because they kept charge of the sanctuary when Israel went astray?
options: The Levitical priests, the sons of Zadok
The sons of Kohath
The sons of Aaron generally
The prophets of the sons of Asaph
questions.correctAnswer: The Levitical priests, the sons of Zadok
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 44:15 (ESV): "But the Levitical priests, the sons of Zadok, who kept the charge of my sanctuary when the people of Israel went astray from me, shall come near to me to minister to me."

questions.question: What kind of garments must the Zadokite priests wear when they enter the gates of the inner court?
options: Linen garments; they shall not put on anything woolen
Garments woven with gold and purple thread
Skins of the sacrificial lambs
Garments of sackcloth for humility
questions.correctAnswer: Linen garments; they shall not put on anything woolen
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 44:17 (ESV): "When they enter the gates of the inner court, they shall wear linen garments. They shall have nothing of wool on them, while they minister at the gates of the inner court, and within."

questions.question: Like the ordinances in chapter 42, what must the priests do with their linen garments before going out into the outer court to the people?
options: They shall strip off the garments in which they minister and leave them in the holy chambers, lest they transmit holiness to the people
Wash them in the bronze basin
Burn them on the altar
Give them to the poor as an offering
questions.correctAnswer: They shall strip off the garments in which they minister and leave them in the holy chambers, lest they transmit holiness to the people
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 44:19 (ESV): "And when they go out into the outer court to the people, they shall strip off the garments in which they minister and leave them in the holy chambers... lest they transmit holiness to the people..."

questions.question: What are the rules for the priests regarding their hair?
options: They shall not shave their heads or let their locks grow long; they shall surely trim the hair of their heads
They must shave their heads completely, becoming bald
They must never cut their hair, like the Nazirites
They must braid their hair into seven locks
questions.correctAnswer: They shall not shave their heads or let their locks grow long; they shall surely trim the hair of their heads
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 44:20 (ESV): "They shall not shave their heads or let their locks grow long; they shall surely trim the hair of their heads."

questions.question: Who are the priests permitted to marry?
options: Virgins of the offspring of the house of Israel, or a widow who is the widow of a priest
Any woman from any nation willing to convert
They must remain celibate
Only women from the tribe of Judah
questions.correctAnswer: Virgins of the offspring of the house of Israel, or a widow who is the widow of a priest
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 44:22 (ESV): "They shall not marry a widow or a divorced woman, but only virgins of the offspring of the house of Israel, or a widow who is the widow of a priest."

questions.question: What is the teaching role of the priests to the people?
options: They shall teach my people the difference between the holy and the common, and show them how to distinguish between the unclean and the clean
To teach them how to farm the land
To teach them the songs of David
To teach them to fight the enemies of God
questions.correctAnswer: They shall teach my people the difference between the holy and the common, and show them how to distinguish between the unclean and the clean
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 44:23 (ESV): "They shall teach my people the difference between the holy and the common, and show them how to distinguish between the unclean and the clean."

questions.question: Who acts as judges in a dispute among the people?
options: The priests
The prince
The elders of the tribes
The king's appointed men
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 44:24 (ESV): "In a dispute, they [the priests] shall act as judges, and they shall judge it according to my judgments."

questions.question: What is the inheritance of the priests in the land of Israel?
options: "I am their inheritance: and you shall give them no possession in Israel; I am their possession."
One tenth of all the lands in Judah
The city of Jerusalem entirely
The land across the Jordan River
questions.correctAnswer: "I am their inheritance: and you shall give them no possession in Israel; I am their possession."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 44:28 (ESV): "This shall be their inheritance: I am their inheritance: and you shall give them no possession in Israel; I am their possession."

questions.question: Because the priests have no land inheritance, what do they eat?
options: The grain offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering; every devoted thing in Israel shall be theirs
Manna that falls daily in the temple
Fish caught in the Mediterranean
They buy their food from merchants
questions.correctAnswer: The grain offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering; every devoted thing in Israel shall be theirs
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 44:29-30 (ESV): "They shall eat the grain offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering, and every devoted thing in Israel shall be theirs... The first of all the firstfruits of all kinds... shall belong to the priests."

key_verse_text: "They shall teach my people the difference between the holy and the common, and show them how to distinguish between the unclean and the clean."
